component.name: Microsoft 365 for Linux (Unofficial)
component.summary: Microsoft 365 web apps desktop client with OneDrive synchronization

description.p: An unofficial desktop integration for Microsoft 365 services on Linux featuring native background sync powered by the abraunegg/onedrive daemon, tray icons, and desktop notifications.

screenshot.caption: Microsoft 365 dashboard with integrated web apps and OneDrive status

description.p: Major update featuring native OneDrive sync toggle, dynamic sidebar controls, localized desktop integration, and UI refinements.
First stable release featuring OneDrive daemon sync, tray menu, and Fluent Design UI.
